frase_gancho.texto: A roof on a single column, a waterfall and a stone god: the visit begins outside.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The museum opened on September 17, 1964, in Chapultepec Forest. Its architect was Pedro Ramírez Vázquez. The visit begins before you enter the halls. Outside, you will find a sculpture of Tláloc, a facade with an aluminum lattice, the Umbrella with its waterfall, and a pond with aquatic plants. In the lobby is the mural by Rufino Tamayo. Everything announces what is to come: modern materials in the service of very ancient ideas. Take a moment to look at the light through the lattice and listen to the water.
